sources.snippet: 🚀 Fine-Tuning GPT-2 with Hugging Face Transformers: A Beginner's Journey Hey there! 👋 Welcome to the world of fine-tuning language models. Think of fine-tuning like teaching an already smart student (GPT-2) to become an expert in your specific subject. GPT-2 already knows how to write and understand language, but we're going to teach it to write in your particular style or domain.
